data: Which model had the highest F1 score for 15,000 labeled Chinese QApairs?

The question asks which model achieved the highest F1 score for 15,000 labeled Chinese QApairs. From the caption, we know that the vertical axis represents the F1 score. The x-axis indicates the number of labeled Chinese QApairs in thousands. The figure provides three performance curves: Baseline, SQuAD GAN-CH, and NewsQA GAN-CH. 

By examining the graph at the point where the x-axis value is 15,000 (or 15 on the x-axis), we can see that all three models have their respective lines intersecting at this point. However, the blue line representing SQuAD GAN-CH is positioned above the other two lines at this point, indicating that it has the highest F1 score among the three models. Therefore, the answer is SQuAD GAN-CH.
